cd /workspace/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource, os
svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
        {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}]
req = {'services': svcs, 'rules':[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
       'queries': [['a']*4096, [], ['t0','a','b','c']]}
line = json.dumps(req).encode()+b'\n'
with open('/tmp/heavy.jsonl','wb') as f:
    f.write(line*8)
print('written', os.path.getsize('/tmp/heavy.jsonl'))
PYEOF
cd /tmp && /usr/bin/time -v python3 -I /workspace/submission/main.py < /tmp/heavy.jsonl > /tmp/heavy.out 2>/tmp/heavy.time; grep -E "Maximum resident|Elapsed|User time|System time|Minor|Major" /tmp/heavy.time; ls -la /tmp/heavy.out
